title: Holy Wars...The Punishment Due
lyrics:
[01:28.36] Brother will kill brother, spilling blood across the land
[01:33.50] Killing for religion, something I don't understand
[01:39.19] Fools like me who cross the sea and come to foreign lands
[01:44.95] Ask the sheep for their beliefs, "Do you kill on God's command?"
[01:50.68] A country that's divided, surely will not stand
[01:56.19] My past erased, no more disgrace, no foolish naïve stand
[02:01.95] The end is near, it's crystal clear, part of the master plan
[02:07.54] Don't look now to Israel, it might be your homeland
[02:13.15] Holy wars
[02:25.24] Upon my podium as the "know-it-all" scholar
[02:29.75] Down in my seat of judgement, gavel's bang, uphold the law
[02:33.78] Up on my soapbox, a leader out to change the world
[02:37.64] Down in my pulpit as the "holier-than-thou-could-be-messenger" of God
[02:56.61] Wage the war on organized crime
[03:04.17] Sneak attacks, rappel down the rocks behind the lines
[03:12.32] Some people risk to employ me, some people live to destroy me
[03:20.02] Either way they die, they die
[03:51.04] They killed my wife and my baby, with hopes to enslave me
[04:00.06] First mistake, last mistake
[04:06.47] Paid by the alliance to slay all the giants
[04:15.09] Next mistake, no more mistakes
[05:40.78] Fill the cracks in with judicial granite
[05:45.52] Because I don't say it, don't mean I ain't thinking it
[05:51.02] Next thing you know, they'll take my thoughts away
[05:56.48] I know what I said, now I must scream of the overdose
[06:07.28] And the lack of mercy killings
[06:12.70] Mercy killings, mercy killings, killings, killings, killings
[06:26.30] Next thing you know, they'll take my thoughts away
[06:35.06]
